title: Working with singers: Peggy Lee, Andy Williams, Vic Damone
summary: He accompanied Peggy Lee for about five years, then Andy Williams and many other singers around Los Angeles.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Then I started working with singers more and more. I went to work with Peggy. I worked with Peggy, Peggy Lee for about five years...
Did you go on the road with her?
Mmm-hmm. I worked The Andy Williams Show. After they had cut the staff off, they kept an orchestra for Andy Williams, and I played for him for about five or six
years. Then I played for Vic Damone, and here and there, and different guys, different shows around town -- I played for all the major singers. I even played for Martha Raye one time. Enjoyed that.
You're darn right she's a good singer. Great lady, too.
